name: Unhinged
source:
Sent to investigate a disappearance at St. Lucia Asylum, you find yourself the obsession of its most dangerous and captivating inmates.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
你奉命前往聖露西亞精神病院調查一起失蹤案，卻發現院中那些最危險、最迷人的病人，對你產生了執念。

［摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian App[/url]］
